@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteBinary.sameAsSourceJustification: Binary kilobyte symbol: Hungarian macOS Finder writes KB (LocalizableMerged SP26), and the hu catalog keeps unit symbols international.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteSi.sameAsSourceJustification: SI kilobyte symbol: lowercase k is the SI prefix, and Hungarian writes kB too (GNOME Nautilus hu: 4 kB / 4 MB); distinct from the binary KB.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: International unit symbol; Hungarian macOS Finder writes MB (LocalizableMerged SP25).

@common.sizeUnit.gigabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: International unit symbol; Hungarian macOS Finder writes GB (LocalizableMerged SP24).

@common.sizeUnit.terabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: International unit symbol; Hungarian macOS Finder writes TB (LocalizableMerged SP23).

@common.sizeUnit.petabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: International unit symbol; Hungarian macOS Finder writes PB (LocalizableMerged SP22).
